subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Interagir em situações de intercâmbio oral, demonstrando iniciativa para utilizar a língua inglesa.

components.description_pt: Iniciar interações orais em inglês sem solicitação do professor
components.description_en: Initiate oral interactions in English without prompting from the teacher
components.cc_component_description: Initiate a collaborative discussion by introducing a relevant topic or question

components.description_pt: Manter participação em troca oral em inglês além de uma única resposta
components.description_en: Sustain participation in an English oral exchange beyond a single response
components.cc_component_description: Sustain participation across one-on-one, small-group, and whole-class discussion formats

components.description_pt: Usar inglês para expressar ideias ou reações em situações espontâneas de sala de aula
components.description_en: Use English to express ideas or reactions in spontaneous classroom situations
components.cc_component_description: Use formal English appropriately when presenting ideas or in academic tasks

components.description_pt: Demonstrar disposição para correr riscos comunicativos ao falar inglês
components.description_en: Demonstrate willingness to take communicative risks when speaking English

cc_matches.description: Initiate and participate effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grades 9—10 topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly and persuasively.

Differentiate between contexts that call for formal English (e.g., presenting ideas) and situations where informal discourse is appropriate (e.g., small-group discussion); use formal English when appropriate to task and situation.
